exposure: collaborative obstetric model (laborist plus certified nurse midwife)
outcome: rates of vaginal births after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: Obstetric patients at a mid-sized midwestern medical center
finding: Implementation of a collaborative care model with a laborist and certified nurse midwife on the obstetric floor was associated with decreased rates of induction of labor and primary cesarean sections, increased VBAC rates, and improved staff satisfaction.
mod_finding: Total cesarean section rates slightly decreased after implementing the laborist and collaborative models, but this was not statistically significant.
